sources.title: Finlex — Protocol amending the Finland–USSR frontier régime agreement (60/1969)
sources.institution: Finland Ministry of Justice / Legal Register Centre (Finlex)
sources.coverage: Official Finnish publication identifying the Finland–USSR state boundary as established by the 14 October 1920 Finland–RSFSR peace treaty and describing the signed boundary-description protocols, boundary maps, boundary-mark protocols and related demarcation documents that define the line on the ground.
sources.notes: The 1969 protocol is not used as a substitute geometry source. It is used to prove that the authoritative 1920 boundary definition and later official demarcation/map package are identified and locatable, so the unresolved task is controlled source acquisition/georeferencing rather than discovery of whether authoritative boundary material exists.
